test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 16 Feb 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: In May 2018, the government of India approved 'National Policy on Biofuels' to promote biofuels in the country. Which of the following Indian states was the first to implement this policy?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rajasthan**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Rajasthan** was the first Indian state to implement the 'National Policy on Biofuels' approved by the government of India in May 2018.
 
• The policy aims to promote the use of biofuels in the country, reducing dependency on fossil fuels and ensuring a cleaner environment.
 
• Rajasthan's early adoption of this policy demonstrates its commitment to sustainable and eco-friendly energy sources.
 
• The state has taken several initiatives to encourage the production and use of biofuels, including incentives for farmers and industries.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Biofuels** are derived from renewable biological sources, such as plant materials and animal waste.
 
• The promotion of biofuels is part of India's broader strategy to enhance energy security, reduce greenhouse gas emissions, and support the rural economy.
 
• The National Policy on Biofuels classifies biofuels into three categories: Basic Biofuels (First Generation), Advanced Biofuels (Second Generation), and Bio-CNG (Third Generation).
 
• The policy also outlines the vision for setting up a National Biofuel Coordination Committee to provide policy guidance and support to stakeholders.
 
• Rajasthan's implementation of the biofuel policy includes the establishment of biofuel refineries and the promotion of biofuel crops like Jatropha.
